about: Our own money, counted the way the Atlas counts everyone: payments in are read from the chain at our seller addresses every morning; payments out and card sales are listed here by hand, each with its receipt. Buyers and payees are named by role, never by name. Edit in the lab; a line is added the day the money moves.

out.to: an agent in the trading circle
out.for: its delivery check of our seller check (/who), done first, paid after
